function.name: gmail__search_threads
function.description: Search mail threads with Gmail search syntax (from:, to:, is:unread, newer_than:2d, has:attachment, subject:...). Returns each thread's subject, sender, date and snippet.

pageToken.description: nextPageToken from the previous call, for the next page.

function.name: gmail__get_thread
function.description: Read a whole thread: every message's sender, date, subject, text and attachments.

function.name: gmail__get_message
function.description: Read one message: sender, date, subject, text and attachments.

function.name: gmail__get_attachment
function.description: Read an attachment's text (PDF and text files) by the attachmentId that get_message or get_thread listed.

function.name: gmail__list_labels
function.description: The mailbox's labels, with the inbox's total and unread counts.

function.name: gmail__send_message
function.description: Send an email from the owner's Gmail. to, cc and bcc are email addresses; "me" is the owner's own. To answer a message, pass its messageId as replyToMessageId: the email goes into that thread, and the subject defaults to the original's with Re:. body is plain text.

function.name: calendar__list_calendars
function.description: The owner's calendars (id, name, primary).

function.name: calendar__list_events
function.description: Events between startTime and endTime, soonest first, recurring events as single occurrences, each tagged with its calendar. Default: every calendar the owner sees except holidays (a calendarId reads that one only), from now, 7 days.

startTime.description: ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-10T12:00:00-07:00 (no offset: the owner's own).

endTime.description: ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-10T12:00:00-07:00 (no offset: the owner's own).

pageToken.description: nextPageToken from the previous call, for the next page.

function.name: calendar__search_events
function.description: Find events on the primary calendar by words in the title, description, place or attendees, from a year ago on, soonest first.

pageToken.description: nextPageToken from the previous call, for the next page.

function.name: calendar__get_event
function.description: One event in full.

function.name: calendar__suggest_time
function.description: Free slots of at least durationMinutes between startTime and endTime, busy time taken from every calendar the owner sees except holidays, within working hours (default 9 to 18).

startTime.description: ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-10T12:00:00-07:00 (no offset: the owner's own).

endTime.description: ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-10T12:00:00-07:00 (no offset: the owner's own).

function.name: calendar__create_event
function.description: Create an event. With allDay, startTime and endTime are dates (YYYY-MM-DD, end exclusive). recurrence takes RRULE lines, e.g. ["RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO"].

startTime.description: ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-10T12:00:00-07:00 (no offset: the owner's own).

endTime.description: ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-10T12:00:00-07:00 (no offset: the owner's own).

notifyGuests.description: Email the guests about it (default: yes when there are guests).

function.name: calendar__quick_add_event
function.description: Create an event from one plain sentence, the way Google Calendar's quick add reads it: "Lunch with Ana Friday 12pm at Zuni".

function.name: calendar__update_event
function.description: Change an event: only the fields given change. For a recurring event's one occurrence, use that occurrence's eventId (list_events returns them).

startTime.description: ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-10T12:00:00-07:00 (no offset: the owner's own).

endTime.description: ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-10T12:00:00-07:00 (no offset: the owner's own).

notifyGuests.description: Email the guests about it (default: yes when there are guests).

function.name: calendar__respond_to_event
function.description: Answer an invitation as the owner: accepted, declined or tentative.

notifyGuests.description: Email the guests about it (default: yes when there are guests).

function.name: calendar__delete_event
function.description: Delete an event.

notifyGuests.description: Email the guests about it (default: yes when there are guests).

function.name: drive__search_files
function.description: Find files by words in their name or text (or a Drive query such as "name contains 'budget'"). Returns id, name, type, modified time and link.

pageToken.description: nextPageToken from the previous call, for the next page.

function.name: drive__list_recent_files
function.description: The most recently changed files.

pageToken.description: nextPageToken from the previous call, for the next page.

function.name: drive__get_file_metadata
function.description: One file's name, type, owners, size, modified time and link.

function.name: drive__read_file_content
function.description: A file's text: Docs as Markdown, Sheets as CSV (first sheet), Slides as text, PDFs and plain text files as text.

function.name: drive__create_file
function.description: Create a file in the owner's Drive from text. mimeType application/vnd.google-apps.document makes it a Google Doc.

function.name: contacts__search_contacts
function.description: Find people by name, email or phone in the owner's Google contacts, and among the people they have emailed. Returns names, email addresses, phone numbers and organizations.

function.name: share_file
function.description: Send one of the owner's files to someone: by iMessage, or by email as a Google Drive link Google emails them. The owner is asked yes/no first; you don't ask. `to` is a contact's name, a phone number or an email address. If two people match, you get them back: ask the owner which, then call again with that person's number or address.

path.description: The file's path in the owner's home (~/Documents/report.pdf).

to.description: A name from the owner's Contacts, a phone number or an email address.

message.description: A short note sent with the file; or null.

function.name: find_contact
function.description: Look a person up in the owner's Contacts: everyone whose name contains the words, with their phone numbers and email addresses. Read only.

function.name: delete_app
function.description: Delete one of the owner's apps when they ask to delete or remove it. No need to ask first: it moves to eve's trash and restore_app brings it back. When the name fits no app or more than one, nothing is deleted and the candidates come back: ask which.

function.name: restore_app
function.description: Bring back an app the owner deleted ("undelete", "I deleted it by mistake"), with its saved data.

app.description: Which deleted app, by its name.
